standard_prerequisites.use: Statement lines 844-848: the functors u_phi : C_n -> C_m are cocontinuous with property P, which guarantees the fibre products W x_{g,U,f_i} U_i in C_m and the covering stability.

core_obligations: The construction (statement lines 848-861): objects of C_total are objects of the C_n; morphisms (phi, f) : U -> V with phi : [m] -> [n] and f : u_phi(U) -> V; coverings are coverings of the C_n lifted with identity indices.
Composition (proof lines 863-868): (phi, f) followed by (psi, g) is (phi psi, g u_psi(f)), using u_psi u_phi = u_{phi psi}.

Base-change stability of coverings (lines 868-885): for a covering {(id, f_i)} in C_n and a morphism (phi, g) : W -> U with W in C_m, the fibre product in C_total is W x_{g,U,f_i} U_i (the object of C_m existing by property P); the identification follows from the compatibility of this type of fibre product with compositions of functors (see notes); the family {W x_{g,U,f_i} U_i -> W} is a covering of C_m by property P, and the other site axioms are immediate.
proof_roadmap: Specify objects, morphisms and coverings of C_total.
Check the composition law via the functoriality of the u_phi.
Verify base-change stability of coverings using property P and conclude the remaining axioms.
